reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: A Work batch barrier skips released turn followers (http.follow/v1) and fails the batch with 409 and its exact blocker once it has waited WORK_BATCH_WAIT_SECONDS for earlier project work, so one project's long or uncertain command no longer holds every participant. Selected: the Work batch suites (new uncertain-blocker and follower regressions), diagnostics, contracts and lock order; SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: no interface change beyond the batch's error detail. The cross-project effect was measured on a fake scratch Core.
